sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the use of maralixibat during breastfeeding. Because maralixibat is poorly absorbed orally and 90% bound to plasma proteins, the amount in milk is likely to be low. If maralixibat is required by the mother, it is not a reason to discontinue breastfeeding.
